subject: Mythology
title: Mythology in Law and Government
description: A quick win: understand Mythology in Law and Government.

hook.text: Lady Justice is blindfolded, holds scales, and carries a sword. She comes directly from the Greek goddess Themis.

buildup.text: The U.S. Capitol is modeled on Roman temples. The Senate is named after the Roman Senatus. Democracy speaks Latin.

discovery.text: The concept of a republic, citizen rights, and constitutional law all trace back to Greek and Roman political mythology.

twist.text: The founding fathers deliberately used classical mythology to legitimize the new American government as heir to Rome.

climax.text: Every courtroom, capitol building, and constitution in the western world is built on mythological foundations.

punchline.text: Modern democracy borrowed its architecture and values from Zeus worshippers.

quiz.question: Where does the figure of Lady Justice come from?
options: Medieval Christian symbolism about divine judgment
The Greek goddess Themis, who represented divine law and order
A Renaissance sculpture commissioned by the French court
